descriptionHtml: This event was an inter faculty gaming competition held at IT center of University of Peradeniya. The aim of the event was to create an awareness about IEEE in all the faculties in the university. Students from several faculties attended to the competition and at the begining an introduction about IEEE was given. About 15 teams with 3 members each was participated and the winning teams were rewarded with cash prices.
